title: Comment thread displays replies in reverse chronological order
body:
## Description
During a recorded session in ReviewBoard, the user encountered: Comment thread displays replies in reverse chronological order.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Observe UI state: Comments
2. Observe UI state: Alice
3. Observe UI state: Carol

## Expected Behavior
The application should complete the user flow without errors.

## Actual Behavior
The session shows failure indicators including: Carol.

## Environment
- App: ReviewBoard
- Platform: web
